name: com.ikangai/ai-news
title: IKANGAI AI News
description: Hourly AI news with a reliability status and sources per story. Read-only, no sign-in.

tools.name: latest_stories
tools.description: The newest AI news stories, with reliability status, why each matters, and sources.

tools.name: search_stories
tools.description: Search AI news stories by words in the text, with optional filters. All words must match.

status.description: Only stories with this reliability status.

topic.description: Only this topic, such as Models or Policy & Regulation.

change_type.description: What kind of change: capability (New capability), breaking_change (Breaking change), outage (Outage), pricing_and_limits (Pricing and limits), security (Security), regulation (Rules and regulation), business (Business), research (Research), other (Other)

since.description: Only stories published on or after this ISO 8601 date.

tools.name: changes_since
tools.description: Stories that are new, got a new development, or got a stronger status or a first original source since a time, optionally only for a watchlist of organisations, products, models or packages, and only some kinds of change. Pass the checked_at from the previous reply as since next time, to see each change once. Oldest first; when more is true, call again with that checked_at as since for the rest.

since.description: The checked_at of the previous reply, or an ISO 8601 time such as 2026-11-06T09:00:00Z.

items.description: What kind of change: capability (New capability), breaking_change (Breaking change), outage (Outage), pricing_and_limits (Pricing and limits), security (Security), regulation (Rules and regulation), business (Business), research (Research), other (Other)

change_types.description: Only these kinds of change, such as breaking_change and security. Stories not classified yet are included too (change_type null), so a story classified after your check isn't missed.

companies.description: Only stories about any of these organisations, or applying to these products, models or packages, such as OpenAI, gemini-embedding-2 or vllm.

tools.name: get_story
tools.description: One full article by its id, with its timeline, original sources and further reporting.

id.description: A story id from the other tools, or the story's URL.

tools.name: built_with_ai
tools.description: Things people built with AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex: games, clones of known products, apps, tools. For ideas for your own or your user's work. Each has what was built, how, with which tools, what to take from it, and the author's own sentence saying AI built it. Newest first. That AI built a project is its author's claim; nobody tested it.

query.description: Words to look for. All must match.

kind.description: Only this kind of project. clone rebuilds or replaces a known product.

tool.description: Only projects built with this AI tool or model, such as Claude Code.
